Excavation & Trenching Permit 19 checkpoints across 6 sections.Before any excavation, trench, or pit >0.6 m depth; revalidated daily Download ExcelDownload PDF **19** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per shift or per excavation activity HSE Officer, Permit Issuer [IS 3764:1992](https://infralens.in/code/IS-3764-1992) [IS 14489:1998](https://infralens.in/code/IS-14489-1998) [IS 4014:1967](https://infralens.in/code/IS-4014-Part-1-1967) Related [📐IS 3764](https://infralens.in/code/IS-3764) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Soil Classification (IS 149…](https://infralens.in/handbook/soil-classification) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧steel-table](https://infralens.in/tools/steel-table) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. UNDERGROUND UTILITY SURVEY | | A1 | Underground utility drawings reviewed: power, water, gas, telecom, sewage lines identified
Acceptance: As-built drawings on site; utility owners contacted; clearance letter obtained | Cl. 4 — Pre-excavation survey | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: GPR/CAT scan done; markings fresh; depth of any service recorded | Cl. 4 — Detection scan | OK
NC
NA

Acceptance: Hand-dug trial pits confirm location/depth; no machine within 500 mm of service | Cl. 4 — Hand-dig verification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. SOIL AND SUPPORT ASSESSMENT | | B1 | Soil type assessed by competent person; stability evaluated for depth and weather
Acceptance: Soil report / visual; Type A (stable) / B (intermediate) / C (unstable) assigned | Cl. 5 — Soil classification | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Excavation >1.5 m: side-sloping, benching, or shoring designed and installed
Acceptance: Slope 1:1 soft / 1:0.5 stiff; or trench box / shoring per designed drawing | Cl. 5 — Stability protection | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Shoring / trench box installed per design; struts tight; no deflection; inspected daily
Acceptance: Design signed by engineer; installation matches drawing; daily check logged | Cl. 5 — Shoring | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Spoil / excavated material kept minimum 1.0 m from edge; no surcharge on excavation walls
Acceptance: Spoil set back ≥1 m; heavy plant set back further per depth; no edge loading | Cl. 5 — Spoil placement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. ACCESS, EGRESS AND BARRICADING | | C1 | Ladder / step access in every 7.5 m of trench length; ladder extends 1 m above ground
Acceptance: Ladder within 7.5 m; secured; extends 1 m; non-slip feet | Cl. 6 — Access | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Hard barricade around excavation; warning signs and lights for night visibility
Acceptance: Hard barrier 1.0 m high, 1.0 m offset; flashing lights at night; signage DANGER | Cl. 6 — Barricading | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Pedestrian crossings: walkway boards with handrails where trench crosses footpath
Acceptance: Boards ≥600 mm wide; handrails both sides for >2 m depth; secured | Cl. 6 — Pedestrian safety | OK
